page.overview:
Who is Ozone?

Ozone is a G.I. Joe character from the A Real American Hero series.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Ozone was released as part of the Eco-Warriors subset of the 1991 A Real American Hero toys. As with the other figures in this subset, his uniform changes color in warm water. ---- Appearance: brown hair and beard; light blue shirt with dark blue chest panel, neon green grenades, and yellow straps and gloves; light blue pants with dark blue leggings, yellow shinguards, and black boots
